fields.Name: T191 - Admin ERD Entity Search Narrows Diagram
fields.Description: Exercises the ERD diagram's in-canvas live search filter (onSearchChange + visibleCount recompute) — a bespoke SVG diagram code path, not the generic AG-Grid quick-search covered elsewhere.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, switch to the Admin application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search). Open the 'Data & Schema' section and open the ERD (Entity Relationship Diagram) viewer. Wait for the diagram to render — pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait and do NOT navigate away. In the diagram header there is a search box (magnifying-glass icon, placeholder 'Search entities, schemas, fields…'). Type a partial entity name such as 'User' into it. Success is that the diagram RESPONDS to the search: the visible-entity count pill in the header changes and the set of entity cards narrows to matches (or a clear no-results empty state appears if nothing matches). You do NOT need to open any entity.

judgeValidationCriteria: The ERD viewer renders a diagram with entity cards and a header search box
After typing in the search box, the diagram responds — the visible count pill updates and shown entity cards narrow to matches, OR a valid no-results/empty state is shown
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
